Class AppleScrollBar.AppleLayout

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.ScrollPaneLayout
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.AppleScrollBar.AppleLayout
All Implemented Interfaces:
LayoutManager, Serializable, ScrollPaneConstants
Enclosing class:
AppleScrollBar
private static final class AppleScrollBar.AppleLayout extends ScrollPaneLayout
The AppleLayout lays a scroll pane out so the bars float. The viewport keeps the full inner area. A visible bar is placed on the edge of that area. The four corner components are given empty bounds.

  • Method Details

    • layoutContainer

      public void layoutContainer(Container parent)
      The layoutContainer method runs the stock layout and then pulls the bars back over the viewport. A null viewport returns after the stock layout. absorb(Rectangle, JScrollBar, boolean) extends the viewport across a bar that sits outside it. The vertical bar is absorbed first. The horizontal bar is absorbed second. The viewport bounds are then replaced with that extended rectangle. place(JScrollBar, Rectangle, boolean, boolean) puts the vertical bar on the left or the right from the component orientation. The horizontal bar is placed on the bottom. That horizontal call does not consult the component orientation. raise(Container, JScrollBar) brings the horizontal bar forward, then the vertical bar. The vertical bar ends in front when both moves run. zero(Component) clears the lower-left, lower-right, upper-left, and upper-right corners.
      Specified by:
      layoutContainer in interface LayoutManager
      Overrides:
      layoutContainer in class ScrollPaneLayout
      Parameters:
      parent - The scroll pane being laid out.

    • absorb

      private static void absorb(Rectangle vb, JScrollBar bar, boolean vertical)
      The absorb method extends the viewport rectangle across a bar that the stock layout parked outside it. A null bar returns immediately. An invisible bar returns immediately. A vertical bar with a positive width that starts at or beyond the viewport's right edge extends the viewport width to the bar's right edge. A vertical bar with a positive width that ends at or before the viewport's left edge moves the viewport's left edge to the bar and keeps the old right edge. A vertical bar that overlaps the viewport leaves the rectangle unchanged. A horizontal bar with a positive height that starts at or beyond the viewport's bottom edge extends the viewport height to the bar's bottom edge. A horizontal bar above the viewport, or overlapping it, leaves the rectangle unchanged.
      Parameters:
      vb - The viewport rectangle. The method writes into this object.
      bar - The bar that may sit outside the viewport.
      vertical - True for the upright bar. False for the bottom bar.

    • place

      private static void place(JScrollBar bar, Rectangle vb, boolean vertical, boolean leftToRight)
      The place method sets the bar bounds on the viewport edge. A null bar returns immediately. An invisible bar is given bounds of zero on every side and then returns. A vertical bar uses a thickness of AppleScrollBar.BAR_PX, limited to the viewport width. A thickness below one pixel returns without changing the bar. A left-to-right pane puts that bar on the right edge. A right-to-left pane puts that bar on the left edge. The vertical bar's height is the viewport height. A horizontal bar uses a thickness of AppleScrollBar.BAR_PX, limited to the viewport height. A thickness below one pixel returns without changing the bar. The bar sits on the bottom edge. The leftToRight flag is ignored for a horizontal bar. The horizontal bar's width is the viewport width.
      Parameters:
      bar - The bar to move.
      vb - The viewport rectangle after absorb(Rectangle, JScrollBar, boolean).
      vertical - True for the upright bar.
      leftToRight - True when the upright bar belongs on the right.

    • raise

      private static void raise(Container parent, JScrollBar bar)
      The raise method moves a visible bar to the front of its parent. A null parent returns immediately. A null bar returns immediately. An invisible bar returns immediately. A bar whose parent is different returns immediately. A bar whose z-order is already zero stays there. Any other bar is moved to z-order zero.
      Parameters:
      parent - The scroll pane.
      bar - The bar to bring forward.

    • zero

      private static void zero(Component corner)
      The zero method gives a corner empty bounds. A null corner returns immediately. Any other corner is set to zero width and zero height at the origin.
      Parameters:
      corner - The corner component, or null.
